[LSMP.3.2a] The compiler rejects every aggregation [LSMP.3.2] lists —
`first`, `last`, `rate`, `direction`, `bool_and`, `bool_or`, `count_distinct`,
`count_of` and `contains` — under `sample` with
`DS_VALIDATE_SERIES_AGG_TIME_MODEL_MISMATCH`: each is a ✗ with no footnote in
[LSER.18.1], a combination with no defined semantics. The `SeriesBackendReservoir` *runtime*
backing can compute `bool_and` / `bool_or` over the bag; that capability is deliberately unreachable —
the language contract (the compiler) governs, and it admits only the
statistical aggregations above. `min` / `max` are admitted as order
statistics **of the retained sample**, not claimed as the population
extremes.

The compiler rejects these with the closest-form hint shape of [LSER.15.2],
pointing at `all_time` or `sliding`.
